project.name: ZETA GCI + Collections
project.description: Micro SaaS for solo Philippine real estate agents: BIR-compliant commission & VAT engine, developer receivables/collections tracking, and GCI goal planning.

discovery.targetUsers: Individual Philippine real estate brokers and salespersons (solo practitioners) self-logging commissions on developer, resale, rental, and referral deals. v2: teams/brokerages.

storyMap.title: Receivable entity + auto-create/restate from deal events
Collections math: payments aggregation, balance, dates, idle/aging
Status lifecycle, Confirmed Collectible override, variance & write-off
Ledger UI, detail view, downstream projections & hardening
Aging, receivables by developer, Data Health
Chase list + inline Next Action + performance hardening
Reports UI: five tabs, toggle, year selector, reading guide
Exports, print layout, performance & cache hardening
Contextual help placements & empty states across modules

techRequirements: Relational database (PostgreSQL-class) — FKs, sequences (permanent D001… deal codes), append-only audit log, soft-delete
Server-side pure calculation engine (computeDeal, computePaymentSplit) — the only code path producing money figures; UI never computes money
Exact decimal arithmetic end to end (DB numeric + decimal library); binary floats forbidden in money paths; round half-up to centavos only at persistence/display; ₱0.50 comparison tolerance
Multi-tenant, single-user tenants v1; membership schema team-ready for v2; friction-gating (confirmations + audit) instead of roles
Event-driven read models restated on deal/payment events; monolith-first; background jobs for bulk recompute and import
₱ #,##0.00 formatting; Asia/Manila workspace time (store UTC); mobile-first at 360px for M5 fast-entry and M6 chase list
CSV/XLSX export on every table; one-time v30.x workbook importer (MVP scope, acquisition wedge)

Acceptance anchor: imported workbook must reproduce Total Collectible ₱6,763,497.25 / Collected ₱1,908,192.86 / Outstanding ₱4,855,304.39; D021 NET GCI ₱354,591.84; fixture N1 for non-VAT workspaces — all to the centavo, server-side

build.m02Handoff: M0.2 done. THE SETTINGS WRITE PATH IS NOW A DATABASE FUNCTION PER MUTATION, and that is the pattern M0.3+ must follow: one PostgREST request = one transaction, so the update, its audit entry (rule 12) and any recompute event (rule 3) land together or not at all. supabase/migrations/20260717200000_m02_settings_write_path.sql adds app.write_audit_entry() (actor pinned to auth.uid() — never a parameter), public.update_tax_settings() and public.rename_workspace(); all SECURITY INVOKER so RLS still governs. M0.1's src/lib/audit/write.ts is DELETED — do not resurrect update-then-audit. RECOMPUTE CONTRACT: settings_change_event is a durable queue emitted atomically with the change, carrying restating fields old->new as exact strings + audit_entry_id; consumption is one-way (trigger-enforced) so M1 cannot double-restate. M1 drains it via pendingRecomputeEvents() (src/lib/settings/recompute-queries.ts) and implements countAffectedDeals(), which returns 0 until deals exist — that one function turns on real counts in the confirmation copy, the event and the trail. FRICTION GATE now has its first consumer and a footgun to know: ConfirmGate owns its action state and unmounts on success when rendered conditionally, so a callback fired from an effect inside it NEVER RUNS — wrap the action to capture the outcome in the parent (see tax-settings-form.tsx; the pattern is documented in confirm-gate.tsx). The gate decision is server-side from the server's own diff (MONEY_RESTATING_FIELDS in src/lib/settings/tax.ts, mirrored in SQL); chase_idle_months is deliberately NOT gated (audited only) — flagged for review in progress.txt. SETTINGS CACHE: src/lib/settings/cache.ts, unstable_cache tagged per workspace, on getWorkspaceContext's read path; a cache HIT does not consult RLS, so the workspaceId IS the tenant boundary and must come from an authenticated context — read the header before adding another. Call invalidateTaxSettings() after any settings write. M0.3: add property_type/developer/lead_source to AUDIT_ENTITY_TYPES + AUDIT_ENTITY_LABELS (src/lib/settings/audit-queries.ts) and FIELD_LABELS in the viewer, or entries render with raw column names and cannot be filtered; Developer.comm_base changes emit a settings_change_event with entity_type 'developer' (rule 8). TYPES: `supabase gen types` typed the RPC's numeric ARGS as `number` — the float trap from the other direction. src/types/database.ts overrides them to string; extend it for new RPCs. TOOLING FIXED: eslint now ignores .next-build (lint failed outright for anyone who ran build:check first); tests/alias-hooks.mjs teaches `node --test` the @/ alias + extensionless imports, loaded via --import in test:unit. e2e: tests/e2e/tax-settings.spec.ts signs in as agent2@solo.test (Maria) — auth-workspace.spec uses JD and asserts his AC1 defaults; sharing a fixture makes the parallel files race.
